review_candidates.title: Business Development Specialist
review_candidates.description_excerpt: This role is responsible for identifying and qualifying new business opportunities, conducting lead generation activities, and building strong relationships with prospective and existing clients. Day-to-day tasks include performing market research to understand customer needs and industry trends, preparing and presenting proposals, and collaborating with sales, marketing, and technical teams to align offerings with client requirements. The specialist will maintain accurate records in CRM systems
eligibility_evidence: Role Description The Business Development Specialist is a full-time, hybrid role based in Egypt, with flexibility for some work-from-home arrangements.
Ability to work effectively in a hybrid setting, manage time independently, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
